title: totalUnclaimablePhUSD is the protocol's only record of outstanding un-backed phUSD mint liability, and nothing reads it -- so phUSD.totalSupply() understates the true obligation by exactly that amount
description: totalUnclaimablePhUSD (:181) is the protocol's only record of outstanding un-backed phUSD mint liability, and no consumer reads it. phUSD.totalSupply() therefore understates the true outstanding obligation by exactly that amount.
impact: Documentation / off-chain accounting only. No value at risk.
recommendation: Documentation only, no code change required: record in SolvencyDetermination.md that true outstanding phUSD == phUSD.totalSupply() + PhlimboV3.totalUnclaimablePhUSD. Optionally expose a getter -- wiring this getter, together with fixing Q-01, is what makes L-01's failure loud rather than silent.
escalationTriggers: Any non-zero desiredAPYBps -- comes alive with the stream (DEDUP-04 annotation); re-weigh alongside L-01 and L-02.
